fields.headline: SINGLES.
fields.body: One against one. The simplest match in golf, and the one that decides most Cups.

fields.headline: ONE BALL EACH.
fields.body: Every player plays their own ball. Win the hole, lose it or halve it. The match is decided on holes, not on strokes.

fields.headline: OFF THE DIFFERENCE.
fields.body: Full allowance. The lower handicap plays off scratch and the other player takes the difference, on the stroke index.

fields.headline: SHOTS SORTED.
fields.body: Enter the handicap index, pick the tee, and every shot lands on the right hole. Course handicaps come off the card you are playing, not off a calculator in the bar.

fields.headline:
YOUR CUP.
LIVE.
fields.body: Free to build, pay to publish, free to play.
